data.long_meaning: Ria is a Sanskrit word meaning joy, delight, and Raja means king. So, Riaj means the joy of a king. The name Riaj carries the meaning “Joy, Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Riaj usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In traditional Indian society, Raja or a king was considered the epitome of power, wealth, and authority. The name Riaj would have been especially significant for a king or a ruler, highlighting his ability to bring joy to his people and his realm. It also reflects the notion that true power and success come from within, symbolized by the joy that a king experiences.
